en: Black‑and‑white reproduction of a mural or painting framed by Gothic stone ribs and ornamental borders. It shows a crowned medieval ruler in rich robes holding a tall processional cross and a large banner with a Christian cross and an eagle. A kneeling armored warrior offers him a scroll, while another soldier with shield helps raise the banner. In the background are more warriors, a man holding a model of a city wall or fortress, and distant troops. Helmets and shields lie on the ground in the foreground. Beneath the image is a caption line in Latin.
